annotation_method: Manual source-only review of proposal file and annotation rubric; no prediction outputs or dataset expected labels consulted during this annotation. Explicit coordinated requests retain inherited verbs; alternatives and same-task steps share groups. Promotional benefits and negation-scoped fragments are excluded. Earlier task context included dataset examples; this is a diagnostic rubric review, not a blinded independent holdout annotation.
note: False-positive cause flags may overlap. Gate recall measures audited proposed spans, not arbitrary unproposed operations. This is diagnostic rubric review, not held-out validation.
